{{Quote|Remarkable, sir. I wouldn't have believe it possible for a human to heal so quickly.|[[2-1B/Legends|2-1B]]|<ref name="RPG" />}}
'''Accelerate Healing''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that required training in the Control skill. The power allowed a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force user]] to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to accelerate the natural healing process within their own bodies.<ref name="RPG" /> They could also use it to increase the effectiveness of healing equipment, such as [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]].<ref name="RC">''[[The Star Wars Rules Companion]]''</ref> The power could also be used on other individuals, and was made easier by the relationship between the two individuals, such as being close friends or family making the power more effective, and the physical proximity between them.<ref name="RPG" />
